issues: The Spellchain (15) branch is encoded incorrectly: it uses dealDamageAllEnemies with followersOnly false, which would also damage the enemy leader for 5 from the first clause. It should still deal 5 damage only to each enemy follower, then separately deal 5 damage to each enemy leader.

The SC (15) effect says 'Deal 5 damage to each enemy leader,' but the parsed ability uses dealDamage to a single enemyLeader target. It should be encoded as the effect that damages each enemy leader, while preserving the separate follower-damage clause.
The activated ability's usage limit is wrong: source says 'Activate only twice per turn,' but parsed uses oncePerTurn true. It should allow maxPerTurn 2 instead.

The activated ability cost is encoded incorrectly: source requires 'banish a Naterran Great Tree from your field,' but parsed uses a non-reference cost shape banishFromField/banishCount. It should use an implemented cost/effect pattern that correctly banishes 1 Naterran Great Tree you control from the field.

The fanfare cost is mandatory, not optional: '[fanfare] Banish two 1-cost cards from your cemetery: Choose up to 2...' should not be encoded as optionalCost. It should be a fanfare ability with a required cemetery-banish cost before resolving the choose-up-to-2 effect. Implement support for mandatory fanfare costs.
The fanfare choice count is wrong: 'Choose up to 2' should allow choosing 0, 1, or 2 options, but parsed uses chooseMultiple with min 1. It should use min 0, max 2.

The second fanfare option is encoded as dealDamage to enemyLeader, which targets a single leader. Source says 'Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader.' It should be encoded with an effect that damages each enemy leader. Implement an ability op for damaging each enemy leader if needed.

The activated ability is missing the Lesson (1) cost restriction. '[act] [cost01], Lesson (1): Give this follower Rush.' should include the Lesson cost, likely banishing 1 Magical Item from EX area. Implement explicit Lesson cost support or encode it as an added banishFromExArea cost.

The fanfare play-cost reduction is applied incorrectly: source says the searched Sparkling☆Days in your EX area 'costs 1 less to play this turn,' but parsed uses playCostReduction on the source card. It should apply a 1-cost reduction to the tutored card in EX area, not to this follower.

The fanfare tutor uses searchDeckChoose with an unsupported field 'reveal'. It should encode 'You may reveal an amulet from among them and add it to your hand' as a top-5 choose-to-hand effect that reveals the chosen card, but reveal support is not available on searchDeckChoose. Implement reveal support for searchDeckChoose or a dedicated top-N reveal-and-add operation.
